product.name: Regular-Fit Linen-Blend Shirt
product.description: Regular-fit shirt in an airy, woven cotton and linen blend with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Turn-down collar, classic button placket, open chest pocket, and a yoke at back. Long sleeves, sleeve placket with link button, and adjustable cuffs with button. Rounded hem. Cotton and linen blends combine the softness of cotton with the sturdiness of linen, creating a beautiful, textured fabric that is breathable and perfectly draped.

materialDetails.name: Cotton
materialDetails.description: Cotton is a soft and versatile natural fiber harvested from the cotton plant.

materialDetails.name: Linen
materialDetails.description: Linen is a natural bast fiber derived from flax plants.

materialDetails.name: Recycled cotton
materialDetails.description: Recycled cotton is cotton made from textile waste in production or from end-of-life textile waste. The waste is mechanically recycled and spun into new yarn.
